name: creative-studio-theme
description: Build tooling for the Creative Studio WordPress theme CSS and vendor copies.

scripts.copy:vendor: mkdir -p assets/js/vendor assets/css/vendor && cp node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js assets/js/vendor/gsap.min.js && cp node_modules/gsap/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js assets/js/vendor/ScrollTrigger.min.js && cp node_modules/lenis/dist/lenis.min.js assets/js/vendor/lenis.min.js && cp node_modules/lenis/dist/lenis.css assets/css/vendor/lenis.css
